title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten no-purchase activities for enrolled UA students or the public, using documented complimentary membership or free admission.

cards.title: Walk the UA Arboretum trails
cards.subtitle: 4801 Arboretum Way
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a daylight trail walk, then use the printable trail map to choose a route through the woodland and gardens.
cards.short_summary: A free botanical preserve with trails, gardens, and outdoor spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission is free; the Arboretum is open daily from 8 a.m. to sunset.
cards.source_title: Visit Us – The University of Alabama Arboretum
cards.access_notes: Open daily, 8 a.m.–sunset; closed New Year's Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas.

cards.title: See work at Sella-Granata Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Woods Hall, 109 Seventh Avenue
cards.notes: Stop in during the academic term to view the current exhibition together; check the gallery’s posted schedule before making the walk.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery where admission is free and open to the public.
cards.evidence_claim: The gallery is at 109 Woods Hall and admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: BFA Graphic Design Students Present Thesis Exhibition in Sella-Granata
cards.access_notes: The cited gallery notice lists term-time hours; confirm the current exhibition schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Browse the Transportation Museum
cards.subtitle: 1901 Jack Warner Parkway
cards.notes: Meet at Queen City Park and spend time with the transportation and local-history exhibits, then continue along the nearby riverfront.
cards.short_summary: A free public museum in Queen City Park by the Black Warrior River.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mildred Westervelt Warner Transportation Museum is free to the public.
cards.source_title: Swimming Together – The University of Alabama Museums
cards.access_notes: The cited museum page lists Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; verify before travel.

cards.title: Take a Hallowed Grounds campus tour
cards.subtitle: Meets at the Gorgas House Museum historic marker
cards.notes: Arrange or join this outdoor walking tour to examine UA’s slavery history with a graduate-student or faculty guide.
cards.short_summary: A free, public 45-minute walking tour based on archival research.
cards.evidence_claim: Hallowed Grounds tours are free and open to the public and last approximately 45 minutes.
cards.source_title: Hallowed Grounds Tours – Department of American Culture & Society
cards.access_notes: Group tours may be arranged pending docent availability; requests should be made at least two weeks ahead.

cards.title: Move together at the Student Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: University Recreation facility
cards.notes: Use your ACT Card with a fellow enrolled student for a workout, indoor track session, or court time without buying a membership.
cards.short_summary: A UREC facility included in complimentary enrolled-student membership.
cards.evidence_claim: UA student memberships are complimentary and include access to the Student Recreation Center.
cards.access_notes: For enrolled UA students registered for one credit hour or more; an ACT Card is required for entry.

cards.title: Plan a Witt Activity Center session
cards.subtitle: University Recreation facility
cards.notes: Coordinate a casual fitness or recreation session with another enrolled student and enter using the membership already loaded to your ACT Card.
cards.short_summary: A UREC activity center included with enrolled-student membership.
cards.evidence_claim: UA student memberships are complimentary and include access to the Robert E. Witt Activity Center.
cards.access_notes: For enrolled UA students registered for one credit hour or more; an ACT Card is required for entry.

cards.title: Swim at the UA Aquatic Center
cards.subtitle: University Recreation facility
cards.notes: Bring a qualifying enrolled-student friend for a swim session and review facility guidance before heading over with your ACT Card.
cards.short_summary: An aquatic facility covered by complimentary enrolled-student membership.
cards.evidence_claim: UA student memberships are complimentary and include access to the Aquatic Center.
cards.access_notes: For enrolled UA students registered for one credit hour or more; an ACT Card is required for entry.

cards.title: Use the Outdoor Pool Complex
cards.subtitle: Outside the Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Make a warm-weather plan with an enrolled student friend; student membership includes this pool complex without a separate membership purchase.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal outdoor pool complex included with enrolled-student membership.
cards.evidence_claim: UA student memberships are complimentary and include access to the Outdoor Pool Complex.
cards.access_notes: For enrolled UA students registered for one credit hour or more; access is included in UREC membership.

cards.title: Rally at the Tennis Court Complex
cards.subtitle: University Recreation facility
cards.notes: Set up a low-key tennis meet with another enrolled student and use the courts through your complimentary UREC membership.
cards.short_summary: A tennis facility included with enrolled-student UREC access.
cards.evidence_claim: UA student memberships are complimentary and include access to the Tennis Court Complex.
cards.access_notes: For enrolled UA students registered for one credit hour or more; an ACT Card is required for entry.

cards.title: Join a UREC group exercise class
cards.subtitle: University Recreation facilities
cards.notes: Choose a class format with friends and attend through your enrolled-student UREC access; check the current class schedule before you go.
cards.short_summary: Group exercise classes offered at no additional cost through UREC membership.
cards.evidence_claim: University Recreation lists free group exercise classes, and student memberships are complimentary for all enrolled UA students.
cards.access_notes: For enrolled UA students registered for one credit hour or more; confirm the current class schedule and entry requirements.
